summary: Part 2 of 4 of the 2.0 Fulfillment App (Sellers) training (04:50-10:20). Pierre walks through creating a shipment request in the Revibe Fulfillment App (AppSheet): setting Quantity Sent and Price on request lines, saving, adding a second and third SKU, checking the Requested shipment and its Related Request_products, reviewing Request products by status, and then the packing, labelling and quality-check rules a seller must follow before the Quiqup pickup. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. Quantity rules, price/buybox behaviour and packing rules are seen on screen or stated in speech. Condition battery thresholds for Excellent and Very good, and the lower quantity bound, are unclear and are not stated as facts.

terms.meaning: A supplier's request to send products to Revibe, shown in the Shipments list with a Request Status and tracking fields.
One line per SKU inside a shipment, with Quantity Allowed, Quantity Sent, Quantity received, Price and Total price.
Maximum quantity the seller may send for that SKU line.
Quantity the seller decides to send for the SKU line; the trainer says it must be between one and Quantity Allowed.
Quantity Revibe received at the warehouse for the line; shown in Request products.
Reference price shown per SKU as 'the buy box'; the default Price is one below it and a higher Price is refused.
The seller's price per unit for the line; the lower it is, the more the seller sells (trainer).
Price multiplied by Quantity Sent on the line; the trainer calls it the total value the seller is paid for.
Status of a shipment (Requested, Picked up, Warehouse received, Cancelled) or of a request line (Requested, Warehouse received, Missing item, Cancelled).
Stage field on the Request products Form; shows Open on new lines.
Shipping document created by Revibe for a requested shipment, printed by the seller and placed on the box.
Courier company set as Tracking company; its driver collects the boxed order.
Check of each device's function, battery level and physical condition, done by the seller before shipping and by Revibe technicians at the warehouse.
File shared by Pierre that sets the criteria technicians use for the QC.
Revibe's own packaging, which sellers should not use for shipments; Revibe handles it when shipping to customers.
Grades used in the QC; each has a rule on scratches and battery level.

unclear.issue: Lower bound unclear: the narration says Quantity Sent is 'between one and the quantity allowed' and later says the error appears when it is 'negative or higher than the quantity allowed'. It is not clear whether 0 is accepted; the form defaults to 0 (t00290.jpg).

Contradictory or garbled speech about adding products: 'can just save my shipment which is {not?} at requested stage' and 'I can still add products into it once the shipment is not anymore at requested stage', then 'now that your shipment is requested ... cannot add any single product'. Cannot tell whether products can be added at the Requested stage. Not stated as a fact.
Narration says 'airway bill created or picked up or warehouse receipt'; the screen group is named 'Warehouse received'. Assumed to be the same stage; not confirmed on screen.
Narration says 'one dirham cheaper'; no currency is shown on screen (values such as 607 and 608 have no unit). Currency not stated as a fact.
Narration says an error message appears at 35; the error text is not visible in frame t00304.jpg. The message is reported as the trainer's statement only.
Word 'random box' in 'use random box carton box' is unclear (may be a mishearing); the instruction to use a carton box is stated as a fact at medium confidence.
Phrase 'devices relatives' is unclear; probably refers to accessories. Only the charger instruction is stated as a fact.
Sticker example '{1?} {to?} 3' is unclear; the SKU example on the sticker cannot be read from the speech.

Battery thresholds conflict. At 09:50 the speech says 'must be 25 percent for very good' and at 09:56 says '90 percent at least' after 'the battery level must be'. Neither is confirmed on screen, so the Very good battery threshold is not stated. The Excellent battery threshold is not spoken (the sentence at 09:44 is cut off).

Screen data inconsistency not explained on screen: Missing item row 010115-080501 shows Quantity Allowed 0 and Quantity Sent 2 (t00453.jpg), and some Request products rows show Price above Buybox supplier (for example 1,696 against 1,613 on the same row), which the Price rule says is refused.
Transcript ends mid-sentence ('most of the devices you sent {not?} matching'); the consequence for the seller is not stated in the evidence.
